name: Cask of Scalder
summary: In Stormwind, a cask of Barleybrew Scalder is bound for an old acquaintance. The fiery ale carries a favor between dwarves.

sections.title: A Dwarven Bargain
sections.body: Travelers who have proved themselves across the Rethban Gauntlet bring Barleybrew Scalder to Furen Longbeard in Stormwind's Dwarven District. Furen is an artisan shieldsmith, and he finds dry times intolerable. The cask gives Yorus Barleybrew a way to call in an old favor and secure fine dwarven craftsmanship.

faq.q: What is inside the Cask of Scalder?
faq.answer: The cask holds Barleybrew Scalder, a fiery brew crafted by the Barleybrew family. Dwarves prize its strong flavor and warming punch.

faq.q: Who is this cask intended for?
faq.answer: The cask is meant for Furen Longbeard, an expert dwarf shieldsmith in Stormwind's Dwarven District.

faq.q: Why is this cask being delivered to Furen Longbeard?
faq.answer: Furen owes Yorus Barleybrew a favor. The cask eases Furen's thirst during what he calls dry times and persuades him to forge a sturdy, exceptional shield for the courier.

angles.text: As a warrior, you can seek Furen Longbeard's renowned smithing by bringing him a cask of fine ale. It is an essential rite of passage for reliable protection.
As a dwarf, you know a fresh cask of Barleybrew's finest can seal a deal or settle an old obligation.
